TAYLOR'S UNIVERSITY
School of Computer Science
PRG2104 Object-Oriented Programming - Group Assignment
Weightage: 40% of the module

Assignment Overview
Your team will build a desktop Library Booking application in Java. Read the whole brief before you start,
and keep every version of your code in a shared Git repository.

Marking Scheme
Component                                        Marks
Requirements analysis and UML diagrams .......... 15 marks
Java application (source code and features) ..... 40 marks
Testing report .................................. 15 marks
User manual ..................................... 10 marks
Video demonstration (max 10 minutes) ............ 10 marks
Group meetings log .............................. 10 marks
Total                                            100 marks

Late Submission
5 marks will be deducted for each day the assignment is late.

Grade   Marks
A       80 and above
A-      75 – 79
B+      70 – 74
B       65 – 69
